en: A colored postcard view over a coastal city with dense low buildings and red-tiled roofs. In the foreground are domed structures and the tall minaret of a mosque. In the distance, by the sea, stands a round tower near the waterfront. Ships are visible in the harbor under a sunset sky. Multilingual captions at the top identify the scene as a view from the minaret of Acha-Mitcli (Acha-Mitchi) Djami in Salonica, noting the White Tower on the left and the Teke Djami minaret on the right. A website watermark 'www.elia.org.gr' appears at the bottom.
